name: Authors
description: Extract the full author list in publication order from the paper front matter or PDF metadata. Preserve author names and separate them with semicolons in the stored value. Leave blank only if the full author line is not confidently recoverable from the provided PDF.
expected_format: Semicolon-separated author names in publication order
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the author line on the title page or article front matter; PDF metadata can confirm spelling when needed.
example_answer: Marie Schott; Daniel León-Periñán; Elena Splendiani
scoring_notes: Minor punctuation or whitespace normalization is acceptable if author order and identity are preserved.
gold_annotation_notes: Prefer the author line from the paper over inferred bibliographic exports.

name: Publication Year
description: Extract the 4-digit publication year of this paper. Use the year shown in the PDF metadata or article front matter. Leave the cell blank if the year is not confidently recoverable from the provided PDF.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the article front matter, DOI line, journal header, or posted-date line.
gold_annotation_notes: For preprints, use the posted year visible in the PDF if present.

name: Title
description: Extract the exact title of the paper from the PDF front matter. Preserve the published wording and normalize only obvious spacing artifacts.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the article title page or PDF metadata.
gold_annotation_notes: Do not substitute a running head or graphical abstract caption.

name: Journal
description: Extract the journal, venue, or preprint server shown by the PDF. Use the visible publication venue rather than the publisher family.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the journal masthead, venue line, or PDF metadata.
gold_annotation_notes: Do not substitute publisher family labels.

name: DOI
description: Extract the canonical DOI when it is confidently visible in the provided PDF. Store the bare DOI string without a doi: prefix or URL wrapper. Leave blank if the DOI is not confidently recoverable from the PDF.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the title page, header, footer, or DOI line.
scoring_notes: Normalize doi.org URLs to the bare DOI string.

name: Spatial platform or method
description: Extract the platform or named method used or introduced by the paper, such as Open-ST, Slide-tags, HDST, Slide-seq, SpaceBar, Visium, MERFISH, seqFISH, or Stereo-seq. Use the method name the paper foregrounds.
evidence_expectation: Primarily text evidence from the title, abstract, and early results.
scoring_notes: Prefer the named platform over a generic umbrella label.
gold_annotation_notes: If the paper profiles a commercial platform but foregrounds a new derivative name, keep the derivative name.

name: Species
description: Extract the biological species of the main experimental sample, not every species mentioned in the paper. Use the species that anchors the main analysis output.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from sample descriptions, abstract, and methods.
scoring_notes: Use the species tied to the principal spatial analysis.
gold_annotation_notes: For multi-sample papers, choose the species emphasized in the representative figure and main finding.

name: Tissue or disease context
description: Extract the organ, tissue, disease, developmental stage, or biological setting of the main analysis. Use the context that anchors the main spatial result rather than every sample mentioned.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the abstract, sample description, and early results.
scoring_notes: Prefer the primary analysis context over follow-up validation samples.
gold_annotation_notes: Human review is useful when the paper rotates across several tissues or disease states.

name: Sample or section type
description: Extract the physical sample type, such as fresh frozen tissue section, FFPE section, embryo, tumor section, brain section, organoid, or dissociated nuclei with spatial barcoding. Use NOT_FOUND if the paper does not state a recoverable sample type in the main PDF.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from methods summaries or sample descriptions.
scoring_notes: Capture the specimen format, not just the tissue name.
gold_annotation_notes: This field is expected to be absent or implicit in some methods papers.

name: Spatial resolution or capture unit
description: Extract the paper's own headline resolution or capture-unit phrase, such as bead diameter, spot size, single-nucleus level, subcellular, pixel, capture area, or 3D voxel description. Preserve the paper's phrasing rather than forcing a numeric normalization. Use NOT_FOUND if the main PDF does not provide a clear representative phrase.
evidence_expectation: Usually text evidence from the abstract or methods, optionally confirmed by figures.
scoring_notes: Choose the main headline resolution, not every bin size or downstream computational setting.
gold_annotation_notes: This field is intentionally hard because papers mix spot, bead, cell, and subcellular descriptions.

name: Calculated capture area from diameter
description: Calculate the approximate area of a circular capture unit from the reported diameter using pi times radius squared. Report square micrometers as a number rounded to one decimal place. Use NOT_APPLICABLE if the platform does not have a meaningful circular capture diameter. Use NOT_FOUND if the needed diameter is not reported in the main PDF.
expected_format: Square micrometers rounded to one decimal place
evidence_expectation: Text evidence for the representative circular diameter; figures can help confirm the representative capture unit.
scoring_notes: Use the same representative diameter referenced by the spatial-resolution field when possible.
gold_annotation_notes: Document the source diameter during gold annotation because this field is calculation-heavy.

name: Main analysis output
description: Extract the main output type emphasized by the paper, such as spatial domains, cell-type maps, clone tracing, 3D reconstruction, multimodal cell-state maps, spatial factors, tissue architecture, or differential spatial expression.
evidence_expectation: Synthesis across result headings and the dominant mapped output shown in figures.
scoring_notes: Choose the dominant analysis product, not every downstream analysis in the paper.
gold_annotation_notes: Keep this distinct from the biological finding field.

name: Key spatial domain or cell-type finding
description: Extract one concise biological or spatial finding supported by the representative map, tissue image, or cell-type/domain visualization. Do not answer with a generic statement such as clusters were identified.
evidence_expectation: Usually both the representative spatial figure and the corresponding results text.
example_answer: Distinct cell states organize around tumor-lymph node boundary hotspots that are not obvious in 2D alone.
scoring_notes: Reward concise biological interpretation tied to the main map.
gold_annotation_notes: This field usually needs human review because multiple plausible findings may appear in the paper.

name: Representative spatial figure
description: Identify a main figure or panel showing a spatial map, tissue image, cluster map, spatial factor, or cell-type/domain visualization that supports the key finding. Use NOT_FOUND if the main PDF lacks a clear representative spatial figure.
evidence_expectation: Figure evidence from the panel that most clearly shows the main spatial map, tissue image, or domain visualization.
scoring_notes: Equivalent figure formatting such as Figure 2A is acceptable.
gold_annotation_notes: Prefer a figure with the actual spatial result rather than a workflow cartoon.

name: Number of bar-chart panels in Figure 1
description: Count the Figure 1 panels that are bar charts or grouped bar charts only. Do not count schematics, tissue images, scatter plots, line plots, heatmaps, or microscopy panels. Use 0 when Figure 1 has no qualifying bar charts. Use NOT_APPLICABLE only if the paper has no Figure 1.
scoring_notes: Scope this count to Figure 1 only.
gold_annotation_notes: This is a scoped vision diagnostic field.

name: Library preparation or chemistry
description: Extract the named kit, sequencing chemistry, capture chemistry, or library preparation workflow if stated in the main PDF. Use NOT_FOUND if the paper does not provide a recoverable chemistry or library-prep name.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from methods or figure captions; figure evidence is optional.
scoring_notes: Prefer the actual library-preparation or capture chemistry description over a generic sequencing-platform mention.
gold_annotation_notes: This protocol field is expected to be absent in some papers.

name: Validation or follow-up method
description: Extract the main validation or orthogonal follow-up method used to support the spatial findings, such as immunofluorescence, smFISH, RNAscope, histology, independent dataset validation, targeted sequencing, perturbation, or imaging validation. Use NOT_FOUND if no clear validation method is stated.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from results or methods, with figure captions sometimes clarifying the validation method.
scoring_notes: Do not mistake the primary spatial platform itself for the validation method.
gold_annotation_notes: Some papers validate computationally rather than with wet-lab imaging; capture the actual follow-up used.
